summary: RETEST of Phase 9 payment maker-checker after backend fix (accounts_overview now allows post_sales). Full E2E via UI passed end-to-end for all 5 requested scenarios: (1) Post Sales booked CVF plot 32 (buyer 'TEST QA Buyer', one 'On booking' schedule ₹1,00,000 due 2026-02-15), navigated to Sales & Payments — the Plots list now loads for Post Sales (previously blocked). Opened drilldown, filled Amount 40000 + Mode 'Bank Transfer' + Head 'Booking Amount' + Notes + expected-remaining-date (partial < balance), submitted → toast 'Payment submitted for verification', receipt shown with 'Awaiting verification' badge. (2) Admin dashboard CVF card correctly shows AWAITING VERIFY ₹40,000 and TOTAL RECEIVED ₹0. (3) Accounts → Verification tab → Pending filter listed the receipt; clicked YES (vq-yes-rc_e364babe4991) → toast 'Payment verified'. Admin dashboard then showed TOTAL RECEIVED ₹40,000 and AWAITING VERIFY ₹0. (4) Post Sales recorded a 2nd payment ₹10,000; Accounts NO with prompted reason 'Amount mismatch' → toast 'Payment returned', receipt marked returned; Post Sales opened drilldown, clicked Correct on returned receipt (correct-<rid>), edited amount to ₹15,000 and expected-remaining-date, Resubmit → toast 'Payment corrected & resubmitted' → pending; Accounts YES → toast 'Payment verified'. Admin final TOTAL RECEIVED ₹55,000, AWAITING VERIFY ₹0. (5) Guards verified in UI: Post Sales sees NO head-verify tab and NO verify-yes/verify-no on receipts; Admin sees NO receipt-btn and NO verify-yes/no (view-only) — Admin retains head-verify tab which is view-tab (no actionable buttons); Accounts sees NO receipt-btn. DB cleanup done post-test.
